name: YamlPresenter
purpose: A readonly YAML source panel with filename, copy, fold, and unfold controls.
description: Present a configuration file with context and targeted highlights.

guidance.overview: A readonly YAML source panel with filename, copy, fold, and unfold controls.
usage: Provide the real filename when available; config.yaml is the generic default.
Use highlightedLines to point to relevant ranges and keep enough surrounding source for context.
accessibility: The section is labeled by its filename and the readonly editor has a source-specific name.
Highlighted line ranges have a text description, while fold, unfold, and copy are separately named keyboard-operable controls.
context: Use for a configuration preview or review artifact; use CodeEditor when the user should edit the source.
